title: Justice and Principles for Kings

questions.question: What sacrifice is an abomination?
options: An ox or sheep with a blemish or defect
questions.correctAnswer: An ox or sheep with a blemish or defect
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 17:1 (ESV): "You shall not sacrifice... an ox or a sheep in which is a blemish..."

questions.question: How many witnesses are needed to put someone to death?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 17:6 (ESV): "On the evidence of two witnesses or of three witnesses the one who is to die shall be put to death..."

questions.question: If a legal matter is too hard, where should they go?
options: To the priests and the judge in office at the place the Lord chooses
questions.correctAnswer: To the priests and the judge in office at the place the Lord chooses
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 17:8–9 (ESV): "...then you shall arise and go up to the place... to the Levitical priests and to the judge..."

questions.question: Who can be king over Israel?
options: One from among your brothers whom the Lord chooses
questions.correctAnswer: One from among your brothers whom the Lord chooses
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 17:15 (ESV): "...one from among your brothers you shall set as king over you..."

questions.question: What must the king NOT multiply for himself?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 17:16–17 (ESV): "Only he must not acquire many horses... And he shall not acquire many wives... nor... excessive silver and gold."

questions.question: What is the penalty for idol worship found by inquiry?
options: Stoning to death at the gates
questions.correctAnswer: Stoning to death at the gates
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 17:5 (ESV): "...then you shall bring out to your gates... and you shall stone them to death with stones."

questions.question: The hands of the witnesses shall be first against him to do what?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 17:7 (ESV): "The hand of the witnesses shall be first against him to put him to death..."

questions.question: If a man acts presumptuously and does not obey the priest/judge, what happens?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 17:12 (ESV): "The man who acts presumptuously by not obeying the priest... that man shall die."

questions.question: Why should the king not multiply horses?
options: Lest he cause the people to return to Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: Lest he cause the people to return to Egypt
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 17:16 (ESV): "...lest he cause the people to return to Egypt in order to acquire many horses..."

questions.question: What should the king write for himself?
options: A copy of this law on a scroll
questions.correctAnswer: A copy of this law on a scroll
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 17:18 (ESV): "...he shall write for himself in a book a copy of this law..."

questions.question: What is the king supposed to do with the copy of the law?
options: Read in it all the days of his life
questions.correctAnswer: Read in it all the days of his life
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 17:19 (ESV): "And it shall be with him, and he shall read in it all the days of his life..."

questions.question: Why shouldn't the king acquire many wives?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 17:17 (ESV): "And he shall not acquire many wives for himself, lest his heart turn away..."

questions.question: Who serves at the priests' side in judgment?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 17:9 (ESV): "...and to the judge who is in office in those days..."

questions.question: What kinds of cases are mentioned as "too hard"?
options: Case of violence, legal rights, or assault
questions.correctAnswer: Case of violence, legal rights, or assault
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 17:8 (ESV): "If any case arises... some case of violence or of legal rights or of assault..."

questions.question: What results from the king reading the law?
options: He learns to fear the Lord and his heart is not lifted above his brothers
questions.correctAnswer: He learns to fear the Lord and his heart is not lifted above his brothers
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 17:19–20 (ESV): "...that he may learn to fear the Lord... that his heart may not be lifted up above his brothers..."

key_verse_text: And it shall be with him, and he shall read in it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear the LORD his God by keeping all the words of this law and these statutes, and doing them. (ESV)
